reason: These fixed interaction families share one sealed installed-app lifecycle, owned native session and process observers, typed permission checkpoints and bounded evidence. The logind observer is a separate authority boundary: typed NoSessionForPID can bind an owned user unit to the active local display, while SSH remains rejected. Keep direct owner imports rather than splitting the same captured-process lifecycle into packages with exported internals for a count target. The 769-contract managed checkpoint covers native retry, focus, refusal and cleanup guards. Retain exactly 37 members with no growth allowance; new families or changed lifecycle authority require renewed review.
